patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I've got this crushing pressure on my chest like an elephant sitting on me, going down my left arm and into my jaw. I'm sweating buckets and feel like I might throw up. Started half an hour ago.
presentation.triageNote: 61-year-old male with thirty minutes of ongoing crushing central chest pressure radiating to his left arm and jaw. He is drenched in sweat, nauseated, and rates the pain 8/10.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 2 is appropriate because ongoing classic ischemic chest pain with diaphoresis, nausea, and radiation is a high-risk cardiovascular presentation requiring rapid ECG and reperfusion evaluation.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has thirty minutes of crushing central chest pressure radiating to the arm and jaw with autonomic symptoms.
clinical.acuityReason: The presentation is highly concerning for acute coronary occlusion, but no current hypotension, lethal rhythm, respiratory failure, or impaired perfusion is described.
expectedResources: IV access and cardiac laboratory testing
Immediate cardiology and reperfusion activation when confirmed
keyFindings: Radiation to left arm and jaw
teachingPoints: A diagnostic ECG and catheterization pathway do not by themselves define physiologic instability.
New hypotension, malignant arrhythmia, pulmonary edema, or altered perfusion would require immediate resuscitative classification.

possibleDiagnoses: Acute aortic or pulmonary vascular disease
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Immediate ECG and reperfusion evaluation would lead to urgent catheter-based treatment if coronary occlusion is confirmed.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: clutching a fist to the center of his chest
signs: fist clenched to the center of the chest
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a hispanic 61-year-old man, sweaty and ashen, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: a clenched fist pressed to the center of his chest. Expression: frightened and in pain. Clearly visible: a fist clenched over the chest and a sweaty, gray face. No text, no logos.
